subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion silently lost — no retry, no notification, no auto-restart on timeout

question: Should this issue remain the broad umbrella for subagent completion loss, or should maintainers consolidate the durable-delivery portion under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/67777 while treating https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90561 as only a limited candidate fix?
rationale: The remaining work spans retry policy, timeout/restart/orphan recovery, visible failure notification, duplicate prevention, task-ledger semantics, and artifact-verification expectations, so automation should not choose the product boundary while overlapping issues and an open linked PR exist.

options.title: Consolidate durable delivery under the planning thread
options.body: Keep this issue linked but make the durable spool/recovery semantics the canonical design thread for implementation and proof.

options.title: Review the linked narrow PR
options.body: Treat the open linked PR as a limited retry/error-visibility improvement and require live multi-agent proof before it can close this issue.

options.title: Split remaining cases
options.body: Close only after maintainers split timeout, delivery, and artifact-verification leftovers into narrower canonical issues that preserve the field reports.

recommendation.title: Consolidate durable delivery under the planning thread
recommendation.body: Keep this issue linked but make the durable spool/recovery semantics the canonical design thread for implementation and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has recent subagent completion handoff commits and maintainer discussion on the partial-fix versus durable-spool boundary.
